name: Out of Control Direction
description: Direction a Tracked or Wheeled vehicle lurches when it goes Out of Control; it must move during its next Round. Skimmers Crash and Walkers Fall Over instead. Only War, Table 8-29 (p. 280); Dark Heresy 2e, Table 7-30 (p. 255) rolls 1d10 with the same odds (1–4 left, 5–6 ahead, 7–10 right).

results.name: 45° left
results.text: 45 degrees to the vehicle’s left. The vehicle moves its Tactical Speed +[[1d10]] metres in that direction. Anything hit by the Out of Control vehicle counts as being hit by a Ram Action. If the vehicle hits anything solid enough to stop it moving (another vehicle, a building) it comes to an immediate halt and suffers the usual Damage from conducting a Ram Action against that type of target, but takes the full Damage rather than half the Damage. The crew/passengers must take a Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or be Stunned for one Round if the vehicle hits something in this manner.
